description: This file contains extension methods for configuring AdoNet grain storage in Orleans silo builder, including default and named storage options with optional configuration.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring AdoNet grain storage in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage as the default storage, with options to configure via Action<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions> or OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage with a specified name, with optional configuration via Action<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions> or OptionsBuilder.
